descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
We are looking for a Flutter Developer (Mid/Senior) to join a long-term product development project focused on mobile applications and connected devices.
 Job in a nutshell 
 As a Flutter Developer, you will contribute to cross-platform mobile development for Android and iOS, support an ongoing architecture migration, and help deliver reliable mobile experiences in an environment where hardware availability may influence testing and delivery cycles.
 What will you be doing:
Design, develop, and maintain Flutter mobile applications
Deliver features for both Android and iOS platforms
Collaborate with backend, product, QA, and hardware-related stakeholders
Support ongoing architecture improvements and migration activities
Integrate mobile applications with connected devices and communication protocols
Work around hardware availability constraints during testing and debugging
Troubleshoot mobile application and device-related issues
Write and maintain automated tests where relevant
Participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies
Contribute to technical documentation
 Requirements:
3+ years of experience with Flutter development
Experience delivering mobile applications for both Android and iOS
Good understanding of mobile application architecture
Experience working in evolving technical environments or architecture migration contexts
Experience with REST APIs and mobile integrations
Knowledge of MQTT, WiFi communication protocols, or IoT solutions is considered a strong advantage
Ability to work with hardware-related testing constraints
Good debugging and problem-solving skills
Fluent English communication skills
Availability for a long-term engagement and tolerance for slower iteration caused by hardware dependencies
 Rewards and benefits:
Opportunity to work on long-term, complex international projects
Exposure to modern technologies and structured delivery environments
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
Career growth within a stable and collaborative environment
Wellbeing programs & work-life balance initiatives
Benefits platform - culture, shopping, sport, and more
Continuous learning programs and online courses
Possibility to participate in charity and eco initiatives
